verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Baseten uses API keys for authentication and can attribute usage/costs by API key, user, or model, but there is no documentation of creating scoped or least-privilege credentials (e.g., role-based permissions, restricted-scope keys) for an agent. Missing for 10: any mention of key scoping/permissions model, ability to restrict a key to specific models/actions, or agent-specific credential issuance.
